headline_title: Feb 2026 revenue NZ$50,900 across 284 orders, down 42.5% on January
trend_title: Revenue falls 42.5% month on month, with Chinese New Year spanning nine days of February
trend_qty_title: Units down 26.0% to 1,755, a shallower fall than the revenue decline
structure_intro_title: Premium lines account for 44.6% of store revenue and 4 of the top 10 products
category_mix_title: Supplements lead at 32.7% of revenue from 35.0% of units; milk powder 26.0% from 12.8%
premium_mix_title: Honey holds 30.2% of premium revenue, souvenirs 22.8% from 29.0% of premium units
top_products_title: Westbrook Digestion Support Milk Powder tops the table at NZ$2,100.81 from 29 units
brand_title: Clearfield at 7.2% of store revenue heads a spread where no brand passes 8%
milk_brand_title: Clearfield leads milk powder on 27.6%, with Two Rivers and Westbrook close behind
milk_brand_note: Clearfield (27.6%), Two Rivers (21.3%) and Westbrook (21.0%) together carry most of the category, with Fernvale last of the five at 12.7%. Shelf positioning decisions in this category will move a large share of it.
pickup_title: Pickup revenue splits NZ$7,153.60 regular against NZ$1,781.35 premium
pickup_comment: Premium pickup revenue moved from NZ$2,051.28 in January to NZ$1,781.35 in February on 33 units. Adding a premium item to the pickup counter display would put the range in front of collecting customers.
functional_title: CoQ10 and magnesium rise against falls in joint care and lecithin
functional_note: CoQ10 grew from NZ$2,183.12 to NZ$2,446.27 and magnesium from NZ$1,470.08 to NZ$2,044.54, while joint care fell from NZ$3,725.81 to NZ$1,099.82 and lecithin from NZ$2,214.55 to NZ$629.43. Fish oil remains the largest at NZ$3,382.65.
channel_title: Export units down 40.0%, local down 9.09%, shifting the split to 56.9% local
channel_comment: Export fell from 1,265 to 759 units while local held closer at 1,000, a pattern likely related to the nine-day Chinese New Year holiday and the freight suspension around it. Local trade at 56.9% of units is the higher share for the first time in the period shown.
concentration_title: Top decile of SKUs carries 34.5% of revenue; half comes from the top two deciles
operations_title: 176 visits and 51 mini-programme leads at a 47.0% completion rate
campaign_title: Chinese New Year gift packs, in-store only
campaign_bullets: In-store customers: Chinese New Year gift packs, available in store only
